copy.tagline: 用子智能体并行执行独立任务

copy.tagline_en: Execute independent tasks in parallel with subagents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run multiple independent implementation tasks concurrently in the same session

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会按照你给的实现计划，为每个独立任务分派全新的子代理来独立完成，并依次进行任务审查和最终审查，全程无需你干预，直到完成或遇到阻塞。
howto.when: 当你给出一个包含多个独立任务的实现计划并指示Claude在当前会话中执行时，该技能自动触发。

say.text: 请按照这个实现计划，用子代理逐个执行每个独立任务。
say.note: Claude会分派子代理并审查结果。

say.text: 帮我用子代理驱动开发模式完成这个计划中的全部任务。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude will execute your implementation plan by dispatching a fresh subagent for each independent task, followed by task review and final branch review, without requiring your intervention until completion or a blockage.
howto.when_en: This skill triggers when you provide an implementation plan with independent tasks and instruct Claude to execute it in the current session.

say_en.text: Please execute each independent task from this plan using subagents.
say_en.note: Claude dispatches subagents and reviews results.

say_en.text: Help me complete all tasks in this plan using subagent-driven development.
